official_process.required_support: strictly more than 80% of trusted validators continuously for two weeks
official_process.activation_sequence: Flag Ledger -1 validators submit votes; Flag Ledger +1 records EnableAmendment status; Flag Ledger +2 applies enabled amendment to transactions.

observations.claim: Kraken XRP/USD last was $1.28084 with a $1.28076 bid and $1.28085 ask; 24-hour reported volume was about 28.54M XRP.
Binance XRPUSDT perpetual mark was 1.28208433, index 1.28204424 and lastFundingRate 0.0001 at server time 13:29:55 UTC.

fixCleanup3_4_0 had 33/35 votes in tracker views and an earliest activation estimate of 14:46:22 UTC, but the capture cutoff was 14:14:02 UTC and no validated-ledger activation evidence was retrieved.
CoinDesk reported 19 votes for LendingProtocol and 21 for SingleAssetVault, below the 29/35 threshold; fixCleanup3_4_0 does not itself activate those separate amendments.
No synchronized Binance open-interest or 100-level depth values were captured in this run.

competing_hypotheses.claim: fixCleanup3_4_0 activates after the first eligible flag-ledger sequence following the 14-day majority window, if support remains above 80%.
support: XRPLWin reports 33/35 and majority since Oct 21 14:46:22 UTC.
Official XRPL docs define the two-week support and flag-ledger process.
disconfirming_or_missing: No direct node feature/ledger_entry response or EnableAmendment pseudo-transaction was captured.
Bithomp displays an ETA with unspecified timezone.
tests: Query the Amendments ledger entry and feature method through at least two independent public XRPL nodes after the window.
Inspect validated ledgers around the first eligible flag ledger for the amendment ID in EnableAmendment with Flags absent/zero.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Activation may be delayed if trusted-validator support falls to 80% or less or the next flag-ledger sequence has not yet recorded enablement.
support: Official XRPL docs say losing the majority resets the two-week period.
The tracker ETA is explicitly an earliest time, not an activation guarantee.
disconfirming_or_missing: No post-cutoff validator-vote history was captured.
tests: Recheck trusted-validator vote count and validated-ledger amendment state after 14:46 UTC; retain any majority-loss event.

competing_hypotheses.claim: fixCleanup3_4_0 activation does not mean native XRPL lending or SingleAssetVault becomes live.
support: The lending and vault amendments are separate and were reported at 19 and 21 votes, below 29.
disconfirming_or_missing: No direct node response for those separate amendment IDs was captured.
tests: Query each separate amendment ID on independent public nodes and verify enabled status in validated ledger state.

data_quality.no_averaging_policy: Do not average validator counts, activation ETAs, spot/perpetual quotes or provider aggregates.
